Keep the existing validation and error behavior unchanged. Review comments at @uwp/App.cpp: - Around line 51-86: Validate the job ID in the `content` read inside the job-dispatch flow before the schema checks or `e0::run_job`: when present, require it to match the file `stem` and reject mismatches before dispatch. Leave behavior unchanged when `job_id` is absent. - Around line 109-116: Update the `Suspending` handler to obtain a suspension deferral and complete it from a bounded background waiter, rather than returning immediately after writing the `.cancel` marker. Use `active_changed` to detect when the worker clears `active_job`, notify it on completion, and wait with a timeout while releasing `active_mutex` so the UI handler stays responsive. --- Nitpick comments: Review comments at @.github/workflows/e0-uwp.yml: - Around line 14-16: Pin the external actions used by this workflow, including actions/checkout, microsoft/setup-msbuild, and NuGet/setup-nuget, to reviewed full-length commit SHAs, and retain each release version in a trailing comment.
